content.snl: def-hyp(__list__(Type.annotation(@F, Analysis.PFun), Type.annotation(@L, Real)), __list__(Analysis.limNegInf(F, @y, L), Analysis.limPosInf(F, @y, L), Analysis.limInf(F, @y, L)), Logic.and(Logic.exists-typed(@M, Real, Logic.and($#0 > 0$(M), Set.subset($\left(#0,\ +\infty\right)$(M), Analysis.domain(F)))), Logic.forall-typed(@epsilon, Real, Logic.implies($#0 > 0$(epsilon), Logic.exists-typed(@M, Real, Logic.and($#0 > 0$(M), Logic.forall-typed(@y, Real, Logic.implies(Set.mem(y, $\left(#0,\ +\infty\right)$(M)), Set.mem(Type.apply(Analysis.map(F), y), Analysis.nbh(L, epsilon))))))))))

values.en:
Three variants sharing the two-clause shape. At `+∞` the region is a ray `(M, +∞)`; at `−∞` it is `(−∞, −M)`; the two-sided `∞` limit requires both rays to lie in the domain and the epsilon condition to hold on both simultaneously with a *common* `M`.

Requiring one threshold for both rays, rather than one per ray, is the same uniformity move that makes the sequence definition non-vacuous.
values.zh-CN:
三个变体具有相同的双条件结构。在 `+∞` 处，区域是射线 `(M, +∞)`；在 `−∞` 处，区域是 `(−∞, −M)`；双侧的 `∞` 极限要求两条射线都包含于定义域，并要求 epsilon 条件以一个*共同的* `M` 同时在两条射线上成立。

要求两条射线共用一个阈值，而非各用一个阈值，与使数列定义不致空泛所采用的一致性处理相同。
